Commentary.Commentary: We are back. The Kiwis are out in the middle. Mason Clarke to bowl first. Arjun Kumal and Deepak Bohara to open for Nepal...
...THE CHASE...

Both added more than 150 but Oscar Jackson fell after his fifty. New Zealand Under-19 did lost few wickets after that but Snehith Reddy stood tall right till the last over to give a dominating total. Nepal didn't made the most of the pressure they created. They let the Kiwis off the hook and now have a big mountain to climb. Their fielding was okayish as well. Now then! A big total for Nepal to chase. They need someone to play a big innings. New Zealand Under-19 will back to chase this down. Join us back for the chase in a while.

A standing ovation for Reddy as he makes his way back. What a knock from the youngster. He single-handedly has scored almost half of the runs. The openers started really well for the Kiwis. Nepal bowled well to at the top  but it was their spinners who made of the difference. Tilak Bhandari and Subash Bhandari handled the middle phase well. However, the pair of Snehith Reddy and Oscar Jackson got through the pressure before punishing them off. They started slow but once both got settled. Runs were flowing.
